page.title: Packages

namespace.description: Assigned by the system and permanent. It is the first segment of every package URL.
namespace.suspendedBody: Its packages are not served to clients and cannot be changed. Contact an administrator to restore it.

quota.title: Quota usage
quota.description: Limits that apply to everything in your namespace.

empty.title: No packages yet

slugError.tooLong: The slug can be at most {{max}} characters.
